task_title: [P2] GET /api/v1/taxonomy truncates at 1000 classes with no pagination/total/notice
task_criteria: 1) GET /api/v1/taxonomy accepts optional limit/offset query params (default limit 1000, clamped to 1..1000; offset >= 0) and the response envelope carries total, limit, offset, truncated alongside the unchanged tree field; total equals the full problem-class count (== /api/v1/stats total_problems) regardless of window. 2) Regression tests in internal/api/handlers_test.go cover: default window unchanged, limit/offset honored, truncated=true when a window is smaller than total, truncated=false when complete, and an out-of-range offset returns an empty tree with correct total. 3) docs/api-reference.md GET /api/v1/taxonomy section and docs/integration.md document the params and the default window of 1000. 4) The Explore UI (web/js/explore.js) names the truncation on screen (visible 'showing X of N' notice) and can load the remaining classes (load-more/paging control that fetches the next page). 5) ch:trace row=DF-OFF-BY-ONE-53 marker comment present in a committed test artifact; marker binds to the implementation commit; committed tree greppable: grep -c 'ch:trace row=DF-OFF-BY-ONE-53' internal/api/handlers_test.go >= 1. 6) go build ./... , go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 all pass on the merged tree.
